source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text:
That sounds great! Whereabouts are you going?
I have a UI/UX design question I wanted to get your opinion on. The shell/dashboard has a collapsible panel, currently shown to the left. Some apps may also have a collapsible panel, in this example also shown on the left. It occurs to me that if there are two panels (shell plus app) they could display and collapse on opposite sides of the screen. Firstly what do you think of this idea and secondly which side should each one go. I'm leaning towards the shell panel on the right. I may prototype each so we can experiment. Any thoughts are welcome.

source_message.text:
That's an interesting view \[sic\]. Everyone's focus naturally returns to the left hand side, at least in the western world. Panels on both sides might be a bit too unnatural.

The Sign In page is generated by AWS Cognito but can be styled. That's what I created the background for. If you open <https://d2oh0ug4dgao74.cloudfront.net> and click on Sign In you'll see what I mean. I am using the same background to implement the Provisioning Wizard. I have the functionality working but need to revisit the styling. I'll send it to you but probably not for a couple of days. The various standard pages like Cookie and Privacy are PDFs that I can just open in a separate tab for now.
